cases.country sigue siendo text NULL-able (esta migración no lo endurece)
SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='cases' AND column_name='country' AND is_nullable='YES' AND data_type='text'
"total": 1
la vista existe y es una vista
SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname='audit_dashboard_metrics' AND c.relkind='v'
"total": 1
la vista expone 32 columnas (31 previas + channel)
SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='public.audit_dashboard_metrics'::regclass AND attnum > 0 AND NOT attisdropped
"total": 32
la vista PROYECTA channel (lo que habilita el filtro)
SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='public.audit_dashboard_metrics'::regclass AND attnum > 0 AND NOT attisdropped AND attname='channel'
"total": 1
las 7 dimensiones del caso siguen proyectadas

SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_attribute WHERE attrelid='public.audit_dashboard_metrics'::regclass AND attnum > 0 AND NOT attisdropped AND attname IN ('country','channel','campus','modality','project','responsible','guideline')
"total": 7
la vista NO es accesible por anon/authenticated

SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_class c CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(c.relacl) g WHERE c.oid='public.audit_dashboard_metrics'::regclass AND g.grantee IN ((SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='anon'), (SELECT oid FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='authenticated'))
"total": 0
project_admin tiene SELECT en la vista

SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_class c CROSS JOIN LATERAL aclexplode(c.relacl) g WHERE c.oid='public.audit_dashboard_metrics'::regclass AND g.grantee='project_admin'::regrole AND g.privilege_type='SELECT'
"total": 1
